name: Stir-fried forest greens
summary: Forest greens stir-fried and served in the same meal as bitter-eggplant soup and bamboo rice.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 23 May 2023 names a stir-fry of forest greens in the meal visitors miss.
howToEat: Eat it with the snakehead sour soup and the bamboo rice.
where: Stilt-house meals in Buon Don, Lak, and Buon Ma Thuot.
seoTitle: Rau rung xao — stir-fried forest greens
seoDescription: Stir-fried forest greens with bitter-eggplant soup and bamboo rice in Buon Don, Lak, and Buon Ma Thuot.
